resources.string: Freedoom Live Wallpaper
An endless battle on your home screen. Freedoom sprites, original timing, minimal battery use.
This device has no live wallpaper picker. Set it from Settings, Wallpaper.
Frame rate
The scene always thinks at the original 35 steps a second. This is only how often it is drawn, and it is the one setting that changes battery use.

Point this at an IWAD you already own and its sprites, palette, floors and numerals replace the bundled ones. The file is copied into this app and never leaves your device.
